title: Daily Temperatures
hints: Brute force scans forward from each day until a warmer one: O(n^2) on a falling sequence. As you sweep left to right, which earlier days are still waiting for their answer, and in what order do they get resolved?
The waiting days form a stack whose temperatures are non-increasing from bottom to top. A new warmer day resolves the top of the stack first, then the next, as long as they are colder than today.
Keep a stack of indices. For each day i: while the stack top is colder than temps[i], pop it and set answer[top] = i - top. Then push i. Every index is pushed and popped at most once, so it is O(n).
